status: Frozen before any repair-round model output; exposed synthetic development cases, not human gold.

evaluationBoundary.matching: Material semantic events, not IDs/order. Read allowedFieldAlternatives before scoring. Required subset is insufficient: inspect all extra actions, roles, source links, claims, unknowns, and questions.
evaluationBoundary.failureHandling: Retain every first attempt, timeout, refusal and invalid result. No selected retries or post-output expectation edits.
evaluationBoundary.scope: Contract 2.0.0 financial and account requests. No legal/employer certification, user effectiveness, independent benchmark or broad accuracy claim.

rolePolicyBeforeOutputs.explicitCompanyHR: our Human Resources department supports employer for that receiving payroll event; no identity verification follows.
rolePolicyBeforeOutputs.externalHR: Explicit external supplier is third_party, not employer; negated company-HR mentions cannot establish the recipient.
rolePolicyBeforeOutputs.ambiguousOccupations: Printer, task platform or HR alone may remain unknown absent an explicit role cue. Do not demand a known role merely from a business purpose. The reused FR02/FR08 sources add an explicit external supplier cue in RR04/RR07.
rolePolicyBeforeOutputs.bareProhibition: A source-supported bare own-money prohibition may use mechanism none or task_recharge without being marked wrong. Polarity and resource must remain correct.
rolePolicyBeforeOutputs.binding: A role cue elsewhere in the evidence or in labels is not receiver binding for every action.

metamorphicRelations.change: Append a same-event explicit company-funding reply and two actual prohibitions.
metamorphicRelations.requiredOutcome: Replace obsolete unresolved payment with one source-linked requested company transfer, retain both prohibitions, remove obsolete funds question.

metamorphicRelations.change: Contrast affirmative same-event clarification with distinct invoices, negated sameness or different amounts.
metamorphicRelations.requiredOutcome: Consolidate only the explicit compatible same event. Never use later company money to erase a distinct or explicitly personal earlier demand.
